name: vibecheck
description: Visual, AI-explained code navigation for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++ and Java — a color-coded Explain view, function flowcharts, and class diagrams.

vibecheck.javaPath.description: Path to the Java executable used to run PlantUML. Set this if Java is not in your system PATH, or to use a specific Java installation.

vibecheck.classExcludePatterns.description: Comma-separated directory names to exclude from class diagram scanning.

vibecheck.debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to the 'VibeCheck' output channel. Useful for diagnosing blank sidebar or diagram generation issues.

vibecheck.llm.enabled.description: Show an LLM-written summary of the selected function above the diagram.

vibecheck.llm.provider.description: Provider preset selected in the VibeCheck sidebar. Configure its base URL, model ID, timeout, and endpoint-specific key using the sidebar gear panel. All presets use OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions.

enumDescriptions: Update after function edits (1.2-second debounce); reuse unchanged summaries.
Only request a summary when Generate/Regenerate summary is pressed.
vibecheck.llm.updateMode.description: When to generate AI summaries. The Regenerate summary button always requests a fresh summary.

vibecheck.llm.analyze.description: Ask the configured model to flag algorithmic inefficiencies and colour the corresponding diagram nodes. Sends the current function/file source and diagram source to that endpoint.

vibecheck.llm.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Use http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 for LM Studio, http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 for Ollama.

vibecheck.llm.model.description: Model name sent to the endpoint.

vibecheck.llm.apiKey.description: Legacy settings-based API key. Prefer entering the key in the VibeCheck sidebar gear panel, which uses VS Code secret storage. Environment fallback: VIBECHECK_LLM_KEY or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

vibecheck.llm.timeoutMs.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for slow local models.
